comparison.objective: Rotate manifold fittings to establish a leak-free coolant path from supply to machine.
comparison.physical_skill: Turns multiple large T-handled revolute fittings and plans a connectivity route; no fine hex tool, captive fastener, or lock retention is used.
comparison.success_condition: Measured quarter-turn angles must produce outlet connectivity without open ends, followed by hand clearance.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest rotary-adjustment record, but it tests combinatorial pipe routing with symbolic coolant connectivity. The candidate tests one component's physical lock and measured energy-absorption response. The record provides no torque or fluid-physics thresholds, reinforcing—not causing—the mechanical distinction.
